title: John Ternus hypes 'huge launch next week' in first memo as Apple CEO | TechCrunch
summary: John Ternus has officially taken the reins as Apple CEO, succeeding Tim Cook, who held the role for 15 years. The company’s former senior vice president of Hardware Engineering, Ternus enters the CEO role at a critical time for Apple.
